# shibumistack.dev

> A small web stack: Bun, Hono, Zod, Drizzle, SQLite, Alpine, and Nanostores. Clear seams. No hidden runtime.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.md)
- [Roadmap](/building.md)
- [shibumi-server](/server.md)
- [DX plan](/dx.md)
- [Brand](/brand.md)

## In development

- [`shibumi-server`](/server.md): an open-source Bun service for signed GitHub webhook deploys to rootless Podman behind Caddy, with host preflight, bounded builds, health checks, two retained rollback images, no-write app previews, DNS and Caddy guidance, owned ship scripts with SSH status, update warnings, and safe uninstall behavior that preserves machine config by default. Public templates contain no machine credentials; real configuration and secrets stay on the VPS.
